## Frontier (seed concepts awaiting a source)
Modes of thinking the corpus *implies* but no single book has yet anchored. Promote to a full
page when a book supports it:
- **attention-and-focus** — deep work, attention as the scarce resource.
- **deliberate-practice** — how skill is actually built (beyond [[skill-automation]]).
